posts.author: darthmarth
posts.body:
Not sure if this would work in XP, since I don't have as much experience with that one.  But you could use simple eventing to determine player/follower positions and make a conversation scene.  As an example, in the image below, I have my character talk to a follower at two points in this scene (there's only one follower, though, so it's easier).  When the character passes the blue square, it starts a "cinematic" event which makes the player walk up to the desk to talk to that wizard guy.  Since I can determine the player's path here, and thus the location of the followers, I can make the player sprite turn to a follower and address them.  I do the same thing afterwards out in the hall.  When the player passes the red square, I have another event that makes them turn around and have a conversation with the first follower.
Again, I know this may not help, but this thread also covers how to force followers to move or change direction during an event like this in MV.  I haven't tried it in XP, but it's possible a similar script can be used.
Set the move route of followers
